nodes.label: Website UI/UX Upgrade Brief
nodes.rationale: Enhance the existing Cubic Technologies site rather than redesign from scratch; target a premium SaaS/agency feel with subtle (not flashy) animation, high trust and conversion, while keeping existing branding, colors, and layout consistent.

nodes.label: Animated Hero Section
nodes.rationale: Animated word-swap headline (Digital Vision / Startup Ideas / Business Growth / Scalable Products), subtle animated gradient/particles background, and hover/tap micro-interactions on CTA buttons.

nodes.label: Sticky Blur Navbar
nodes.rationale: Sticky navbar gaining blur and shadow on scroll, animated active-link indicator, and a CTA button with glow/pulse hover effect.

nodes.label: Interactive Services Cards
nodes.rationale: Hover interactions (slight 3D tilt, icon animation, gradient reveal) and a click-to-expand modal following problem -> solution -> result plus tools/technologies used.

nodes.label: Scroll Animations
nodes.rationale: Fade-up and stagger effects on viewport entry plus subtle image parallax, implemented with a single choice among GSAP / Framer Motion / AOS.

nodes.label: Proof & Trust Section
nodes.rationale: Animated stat counters (projects, satisfaction, experience), placeholder client logos, and 2-3 realistic dummy mini case studies to build trust and conversion.

nodes.label: Dark/Light Theme Toggle
nodes.rationale: Dark/light toggle with preference persisted in localStorage and smooth color transitions.

nodes.label: Enhanced Contact Form
nodes.rationale: Real-time input validation, submit loading animation, success confirmation animation, and an optional WhatsApp quick-contact CTA.

nodes.label: CubicTech Logo Mark (favicon)
nodes.rationale: Orange geometric brand mark composed of interlocking square blocks forming a stylized cube/'C' shape on a transparent background; serves as the CubicTech browser-tab icon.

nodes.label: framer-motion Package Requirement
nodes.rationale: framer-motion is required for complex layout animations and transitions.

nodes.label: Tailwind fontFamily (display/body) Config
nodes.rationale: Tailwind config extends fontFamily with display -> var(--font-display) and body -> var(--font-body) CSS variables.

nodes.label: Cubic Technologies Business Website
nodes.rationale: Multi-page digital-agency site (web development, UI/UX, AI solutions, digital marketing) built as a full-stack TypeScript project: React frontend, Express backend, and a contact form persisting consultation requests to PostgreSQL.

nodes.label: Frontend Architecture (React/Wouter/TanStack/Tailwind)
nodes.rationale: React 18 + TypeScript, Wouter routing, TanStack React Query for server state, Tailwind + shadcn/ui (New York) on Radix primitives, Framer Motion for page/scroll animations, React Hook Form + Zod validation; pages-based structure with Home, Services (6 sub-pages), About, Contact.

nodes.label: Backend Architecture (Express/Drizzle)
nodes.rationale: Minimal Express 5 server on Node.js exposing a single POST endpoint for contact submissions, using Drizzle ORM over PostgreSQL, with Vite dev server (HMR) proxied through Express.

nodes.label: consultation_requests Table
nodes.rationale: Single PostgreSQL table storing contact-form/consultation submissions; managed via Drizzle Kit migrations (db:push).

nodes.label: Shared Type-Safe Routes Pattern
nodes.rationale: Type-safe REST endpoints defined in shared/routes.ts with Zod request/response schemas ensure type safety between frontend and backend.

nodes.label: Typography (Outfit display / Plus Jakarta Sans body)
nodes.rationale: Custom typography uses Outfit for display headings and Plus Jakarta Sans for body text.
nodes.norm_label: typography (outfit display / plus jakarta sans body)
